packageRules.description: Go MAJOR bumps move the version into the import path (/vN) and usually break the API, so they can't be applied automatically: gomodUpdateImportPaths rewrites the imports, but API changes still need a manual migration. Hold them on the Dependency Dashboard for opt-in instead of opening PRs that fail CI.
Our own server image is published by this repo's release pipeline; Renovate must not bump or pin the chart/compose reference to it.
